description: U.S. government statistics (Census, BLS, BEA, IRS, OPM, FRED, CDC, Treasury and more): the analyst's method for any question that needs official data. Call once at the start (the analyze prompt already holds the workflow). Topics: workflow (default), routing (which sources answer which questions), compute (compute's functions and survey standard errors), report (what a report needs, in short), style, report_patterns, report_schema (every report.json key). A long topic returns its outline: then ask for a section.

section.description: A section title (or its number) of the topic
